summary: Wrote a 3-phase, 2.75h plan adopting both of the research report's branch decisions: a deliberate gate-20 headroom re-baseline (70400->71500 eager baseline, 21500->22000 and 26000->26500 per-file ceilings) rather than a fourth compaction pass, and a static timeout_s raise 60->180 on gates 3, 4 and 10 rather than a load-adaptive mechanism (left to task 610). Premise re-validation confirmed live: the description's 71712B figure is stale and mis-attributed (gate 20 passes at exactly 70400B), and its 'gates 8 and 10' claim is half wrong -- gate 8 declares 1500s and runs serialized, so the remedy retargets onto gates 3/4/10. Phase 3 redeploys via deploy-headless.sh and runs the full gate sweep; it declares __WHOLE_TREE__.

artifacts.summary: 3-phase config-only plan: gate-20 budget headroom re-baseline, gates 3/4/10 timeout_s 60->180, redeploy plus full-sweep verification.
